title: When loneliness drains the day of purpose
subtitle: For isolation that makes the breath feel unused
description: These readings reconnect loneliness to the rare human chance, so the day is not measured only by who noticed you.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Grace gives the lonely heart a calling larger than being seen by others.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let one meaningful act answer the day before loneliness names it empty.

evidence.coreClaim: This path restores purpose when isolation has made life feel weightless.
evidence.turn: Purpose returns when the day is offered, not merely evaluated for attention.
evidence.practicalImplication: Do one act of remembrance or service that would matter even if nobody sees it.
